  , tree TEXT, parent_ep TEXT, parent_addr TEXT, depth INTEGER, rules TEXT, caps TEXT, title TEXT, reset_at INTEGER, spawned_at INTEGER, peek TEXT, pushes INTEGER, prompts INTEGER, briefed INTEGER, introduced INTEGER, directive_holds INTEGER, harness_session TEXT, harness_origin TEXT, harness_transcript TEXT, title_auto TEXT, title_turn INTEGER, tldr_turn INTEGER, named INTEGER, linked INTEGER, wake TEXT, wakers INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, waker_left INTEGER, hibernate TEXT, wake_ref TEXT, hibernated_at INTEGER, wake_tried INTEGER, wake_fails INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wake_note TEXT, wake_eta INTEGER, wake_declined TEXT, declined_message TEXT, declined_from TEXT, hold_ref TEXT, wake_ticket TEXT, wake_tickets TEXT, mail_at INTEGER, revive TEXT)

name: audit_no_delete
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit
    WHEN OLD.at > CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 - 2592000000 AND NOT (OLD.event IN ('scope_refused') AND OLD.at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 - 86400000)
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit is append-only'); END

name: audit_no_update
sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit is append-only'); END
